title: Create a work permit
author: SOP Capture Studio
purpose: Create a work permit and confirm its details before submitting it for review.
scope: Demonstration of a local SOP project using a fictional application and synthetic information.
prerequisites: Access to the permit dashboard and the relevant work order. All screenshots in this example are fictional.

steps.title: Open Permit Management
steps.description: Choose Permit Management from the navigation menu to view the available permits.

steps.title: Create a new permit
steps.description: Select New permit. Enter the work package and check the proposed location. Redact sensitive information before sharing screenshots.
steps.notes: Solid redactions remove visible pixels from the exported image. Original project images remain unredacted.

steps.title: Review and submit
steps.description: Check the work area, task description and required approvals. Select Submit for review when the details are correct.
